description: This file implements a Suggestions API client for a web application. It provides functions to determine the base URL for suggestions (considering environment variables and a fallback to Datamuse) and to fetch suggestions asynchronously, normalizing various data shapes received from different APIs.

methods.name: getSuggestionsBase()
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for suggestions API endpoints, prioritizing environment variables and falling back to a public API (Datamuse) if none are set.

methods.name: fetchSuggestions(prefix)
methods.description: Fetches auto-suggestions for a given prefix, normalizing the API response into an array of suggestion strings with fallback behavior on errors and empty input.
